BEGIN;

-- Student owns the materialized runtime identity it needs for usage checks.
-- These columns intentionally have no foreign keys to the catalog database.
ALTER TABLE student_practice_task_milestone
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS practice_task_part_id uuid NULL,
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS practice_task_milestone_id uuid NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_practice_task_milestone_part_usage
    ON student_practice_task_milestone(practice_task_part_id, student_practice_task_id)
    WHERE practice_task_part_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_practice_task_milestone_catalog_usage
    ON student_practice_task_milestone(practice_task_milestone_id, student_practice_task_id)
    WHERE practice_task_milestone_id IS NOT NULL;

COMMIT;
